capabilities: Apply a matching template automatically when a Markdown file is created
Match note paths with JavaScript regex or glob patterns, using capture groups in template paths
Insert title, date, and time variables with configurable formats
Apply templates manually to the current file, folder, or entire vault
Preview rule matches and test patterns without changing files
extras: If skip-non-empty is disabled, template content is prepended to existing notes, so a vault-wide manual run can modify many files.
intentEvidence: Folder Templates automatically inserts template content into Markdown notes based on their vault-relative paths.
problem: Obsidian's Templates core feature inserts content on demand, but offers no way to apply a template automatically depending on where a new note is created.
summary: Path-rule templating plugin that automatically inserts template content into Markdown notes based on vault-relative path patterns.
